source_grounded_defect.source: DH-03 White Paper — Pullback Continuation Specialist
source_grounded_defect.canonical_semantic: LOCAL_RECLAIM is a completed S5 close back through a causally known fast pivot/reclaim level in parent direction; the S06 reclaim level source remains the frozen S15 pivot.
source_grounded_defect.control_mismatch: 13A checked the S15 close itself for the reclaim cross, so reclaim opportunities were observed only every 15 seconds instead of every completed S5 bar.

bounded_profiles.semantics: completed S5 close crosses latest causally known S15 pivot in parent direction; pivot reveal time must be after pullback start; reacceleration must occur on a later completed S5 bar
completed S5 close crosses latest causally known S15 pivot in parent direction regardless of whether that pivot was revealed before or after pullback start; reacceleration remains later completed S5
freeze the latest causally known S15 pivot when EXHAUSTION_CANDIDATE first forms, then require a completed S5 close through that frozen level before later S5 reacceleration

selection_rule: No threshold tuning. First require exact reproduction of the 13A control. Prefer the white-paper-consistent S5 reclaim timing if it materially closes the 709->1563 activity deficit while maintaining a broadly compatible raw-win fraction/economic scale. Do not select a looser pivot-age interpretation solely because one scalar fits better.
